tests.name: Floating panel windows
tests.what: Drag a panel tab out of the window

tests.name: Create tool shapes
tests.what: Drag in the monitor, or Sequence › New Shape

changes.title: New
items: Panels can float in their own window.
Create tool: shapes and strokes straight in the monitor.
Import LUTs fills the LUT library on the Color page.
Stabilize and Find Scene Changes work on every system.

changes.title: Improved
items: Library previews show waveforms, transparency and rotation.
Fonts from packs work in text right away.
Motion presets mark built-ins you changed.

changes.title: Fixed
items: Clicking a Graphic's text in the monitor picks the text layer.
Pasted images in an unsaved project are kept safe.
The app could hang when closing during a background task.
